plan.summary: This 4-week block starts a 12-week off-camp boxing strength and power build with one short weekly session that fits around skill work. Week 1 establishes a baseline on the main lower-body lift, then Weeks 2-4 build simple explosive work, squat strength, upper-body support, trunk strength, and brief conditioning without adding unnecessary fatigue. Week 4 trims volume for a light deload before the next block.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build basic lower-body strength and simple explosive qualities while keeping the sessions short, safe, and repeatable.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength work and keep power output crisp with slightly heavier but still manageable training.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Hold onto strength and express it faster with more emphasis on sharp jumps, throws, and sport-friendly power.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a low box and land softly. Step down each rep and keep every jump fast and clean.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if no sturdy box is available. Reset between reps and jump for height.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: This session sets your starting baseline for future squat work. Warm up gradually, then work up to one hard set of 3-5 good reps with solid depth and no grinding.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can set your starting numbers for the next weeks.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the goblet load is too light. Keep the torso tall and squat to a consistent depth.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Keep the body straight and stop 1-2 reps before form breaks.

substitutionOptions.name: Hands-Elevated Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if floor push-ups are too hard. Keep the same body line and full range.

substitutionOptions.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if wrist discomfort makes push-ups awkward. Lower under control and drive up hard.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Pull the elbow toward the hip and keep the torso still. Use a load you can control cleanly.

substitutionOptions.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if lower-back support is needed. Keep the pull smooth and strict.

exercises.name: Front Plank
exercises.notes: Brace hard, squeeze glutes, and keep ribs down. Stop before the low back sags.

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if planks bother the shoulders. Move slowly and keep the low back flat.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.notes: Stay relaxed and light on the feet. Keep this easy to moderate so you finish fresher than you started.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a low box and land softly. Step down each rep and keep every jump explosive.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if no sturdy box is available. Reset each rep and chase height, not fatigue.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Use the baseline from Week 1 and keep all sets smooth. Add a small amount of load only if depth and speed stay solid.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the heaviest clean set of 5 with full depth and strong control.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the goblet load tops out too soon. Keep the elbows up and torso tall.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Leave 1-2 reps in reserve and keep the reps crisp.

substitutionOptions.name: Hands-Elevated Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you need a simpler version. Keep full-body tension and controlled depth.

substitutionOptions.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you have dumbbells and want a more stable pressing option.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Pause briefly at the top and lower with control. Do not twist the body.

substitutionOptions.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you want more support and less lower-back demand.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.notes: Stand tall and do not lean toward the weight. Walk under control and brace the trunk hard.

substitutionOptions.name: Single-Arm Farmer Carry
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if space is limited and you can walk shorter trips back and forth.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.notes: Keep the rhythm smooth and breathing steady. This should support recovery, not bury you.
